KEY FINDINGS
Invest in AI/ML Capabilities: Transit agencies should explore integrating
advanced ML models (Graph Transformers) for real-time prediction and consider
LLM-powered interfaces for personalized passenger services.
Develop High-Resolution Data Strategies: Prioritize collecting and integrating
multi-source, high-resolution operational and contextual data to enable
sophisticated analysis and predictive modeling.
Prioritize Equity in Planning: Implement planning frameworks that explicitly
consider social equity, user-specific constraints, and risk management in
underserved areas, rather than solely optimizing for efficiency.
PAPER OF THE DAY
Public transit gains and spatially uneven travel demand
changes after NYC congestion pricing
Donghang Li, Dingyi Zhuang, Yunlin Li, Chenan Shen, Nina Cao
This paper evaluates the impact of NYC's 2025 congestion pricing on system-wide urban
mobility, finding increased bus and subway ridership but with uneven spatial patterns
using time series foundation models.
Why it matters: It's the first empirical analysis of a major US congestion pricing
program, offering crucial insights into its real-world effects on public transit and
urban travel demand, informing future policy decisions.

ACTIONABLE TAKEAWAYS
Invest in AI/ML Capabilities: Transit agencies should explore integrating advanced ML
models (Graph Transformers) for real-time prediction and consider LLM-powered interfaces
for personalized passenger services.
Develop High-Resolution Data Strategies: Prioritize collecting and integrating multi-
source, high-resolution operational and contextual data to enable sophisticated analysis
and predictive modeling.
Prioritize Equity in Planning: Implement planning frameworks that explicitly consider
social equity, user-specific constraints, and risk management in underserved areas,
rather than solely optimizing for efficiency.
Adopt Advanced Policy Evaluation Tools: Utilize time series foundation models for robust
counterfactual analysis when evaluating major policy changes like congestion pricing to
understand true impacts.
Re-evaluate Network Design Methodologies: Explore graph-theoretic and optimization-based
approaches (like spanning trees) for strategic network redesign, aiming to optimize for
relevant metrics beyond simple coverage.
